title: When the Recipe Sings
author: W. M. Quintana
blurb: Silas Blackwood, a debate champion who can't win the argument at home, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
